title: Eisenkot, Netanyahu Rival and Opposition Leader, Tapped to Try to Form Government
summary: Gadi Eisenkot, a former military chief, hopes to succeed Benjamin Netanyahu as prime minister by cobbling together a coalition after an inconclusive election.
